title: Dulhan Banoo Mein Teri
desc: An NRI visits a small town and falls in love with a village girl. He marries her and brings her home, much to his parents' dismay who hope to marry him to an heiress. A ploy is set to get him to marry the woman of his parents' choice.

title: Judwaa
desc: Judwaa is a story about twins Raja and Prem Malhotra who separate at birth. Years later, they reunite to defeat Ratanlal, a local gangster, who wants to destroy the Malhotra family.

title: Munjya
desc: Strange developments disrupt familiar routines as curiosity and uncertainty lead characters toward surprising discoveries and unexpected encounters.

title: Shaadi Karke Phas Gaya Yaar
desc: A Young Couple Fall In Love And Marry, But Struggle To Be Together With Their Different Behaviours.

title: Brahmastra: Part One Shiva
desc: This is the story of Shiva who sets out in search of love and self-discovery. During his journey, he has to face many evil forces that threaten our existence.

title: Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham

desc: Emotions, secrets and unexpected developments create a captivating atmosphere where relationships are tested and truths gradually emerge.
